linkedin:
Not every AI-titled job pays premium. We analyzed 3,928 remote listings on Loker Dollar and found 487 (12%) explicitly require AI skills. Top pay: Jabil offers USD 132,400–238,400/yr for a Sr. Principal Product Engineer with AI-adjacent cloud expertise. AI requirements appear at Jabil, Sardine, Sycle LLC, Creator, HSS Careers, Censys, and Devoted Studios.

But 78% of listings hide salary. Communication is still the most demanded skill at 41% of listings, ahead of AI (12%), leadership (11%), and sales (9%). AI is a differentiator, not a guarantee.

Methodology note: Data from Loker Dollar's database (2026-10-13), sample size 3,928 listings. Pay figures are self-reported; keyword may miss jobs. Geographic salary differentials and skill depth unknown.

Search 'AI' on Loker Dollar to filter remote roles that list AI skills: https://lokerdollar.com/en/jobs
